description:
Across borders and cultures, familiar flavors create a sense of home. At the best #Huawei campus canteens around the world, Chinese dishes play a central role in daily life. 

Carefully prepared cuisine, time-honored techniques, and shared experiences give these spaces meaning beyond the meal. These canteens reflect how food carries culture and connection. Watch "Chinese Flavors in Foreign Countries" and see how home cooking creates a sense of belonging, even while on the job.
title: A Taste of Home Abroad: The World's 10 Best Huawei Canteens
